description: This file defines an enum AdHocJsonInputParams that encapsulates all possible JSON input parameter names used in creating or updating an AdHocQuery in the Fineract system. It provides methods to retrieve all parameter values and a string representation of enum names.

classes.name: AdHocJsonInputParams
classes.description: Enum representing all parameter keys used in AdHocQuery JSON input.

methods.name: AdHocJsonInputParams
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the enum with a string value.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns a set containing all string values represented by the enum constants.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string of the enum constant name, replacing underscores with spaces.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value associated with the enum constant.
